value.rationale: The source explicitly asks for admissible parameter bounds for oscillatory copulas and only obtains sufficient constraints. The new theorem gives the exact complete family at the natural exponent-one slice, identifies a quadrant-dependence transition that occurs while the simple FGM amplitude restriction remains sharp, and quantifies how the maximal parameter shrinks at high oscillation. These provide model-validity and dependence-interpretation boundaries that neither a routine substitution nor isolated numerical optimization supplies.
